_comment: Sister Bond (docs/PERSISTENT_RPG_DESIGN.md). XP comes from shared expeditions and twin reactions; reactions are capped per expedition so the bond cannot be farmed. Levels unlock content and duo effects, never plain stats.

levels.title: Sisters
levels.text: Two princesses who trust each other with their lives.

levels.title: In Step
levels.text: They start to fight as one.

levels.title: Shared Rhythm
levels.text: Each knows the other's next move.

levels.title: Heartbound
levels.text: A wound to one is felt by both.
